gen-dafont-joystix-fs-spline-sans: Joystix spreads its arcade letters wide, stems barely heavier than arms, while Spline Sans keeps open curves and uniform strokes. Arcade punch above, friendly openness below, and neither crowds the other.
gen-dafont-joystix-fs-synonym: Constant ink and generous curve openings keep the sans-serif body quietly dependable, never raising its voice. Synonym stays in the background beneath Joystix, whose widely tracked arcade lettering supplies the volume.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-almendra: Almendra brings a dignified, bookish serif that carries a deep midsection in every lowercase letter. Almendra stays low in contrast beneath Joystix, whose bold, widely tracked arcade lettering stretches out.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-bree-serif: Outsized lowercase gives the text a literary, refined feel. Bree Serif handles the quiet reading with low contrast, while Joystix does the loud arcade announcing with comfortable stroke contrast.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-port-lligat-slab: Widely tracked, arcade-bold lettering gives Joystix its character, with stems barely heavier than the arms. But Port Lligat Slab brings porthole-wide counters and hugging, literary letter shapes with room to breathe.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-quando: Loud and wide: Joystix tracks its arcade lettering far apart, curves thinning only slightly at the turns. Quando settles in with sparse spacing and a tall middle zone, bookish and traditional.
gen-dafont-joystix-outfit: Outfit reads like cable bent into shapes, smooth and friendly. Across many lines it stays uniform in weight and open in its curves, which lets Joystix keep the arcade swagger.
gen-dafont-junegull-fs-plein: Retro and friendly, Junegull stands tall with pinched curve mouths, while Plein opens a clear channel into each round letter. Closed and sturdy above, open and reliable sans below.
gen-dafont-junegull-fs-synonym: Cast-iron stature, retro grin: Junegull holds a steady line weight, while Synonym lays down constant ink and generous openings. Shrink Junegull too far and the iron stature fades quickly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its lowercase oversized. Junegull adds a marker-like steady line and cast-iron stature, so the headline lands friendly and retro over its low-contrast serif text.
